'''Quadrant A-4''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was the location of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Terrorist|counterterrorism]] operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was known as the Diplomatic sector.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

The terrorist [[Perrive]] had an apartment there.<ref name="o66" />
